import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    pos = 0
    n = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
    q = int(data[pos]); pos += 1

    vals = list(map(int, data[pos:pos + n]))
    pos += n

    A = [0] + vals          # valores atuais por andar
    tree = [0] + vals       # Fenwick (BIT)

    # construção em O(N)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        j = i + (i & -i)
        if j <= n:
            tree[j] += tree[i]

    out = []
    ap = out.append
    for _ in range(q):
        t = data[pos]; pos += 1
        if t == b'1':                     # Bombeiro: soma prefixo 1..K
            k = int(data[pos]); pos += 1
            s = 0
            j = k
            while j:
                s += tree[j]
                j &= j - 1
            ap(str(s))
        else:                             # Mudança: andar K vira P
            k = int(data[pos]); p = int(data[pos + 1]); pos += 2
            delta = p - A[k]
            A[k] = p
            if delta:
                j = k
                while j <= n:
                    tree[j] += delta
                    j += j & (-j)

    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')

main()
